back.es: to suit, to fit (of clothes on someone, usually with an indirect object and bien/mal: te queda bien)
back.example: That shirt fits you really well / looks really good on you.

note: Sentar (te sienta bien) also means to suit, but in Latin America quedar is the everyday verb and the hint fits it well; this sense also covers "to fit" (no me queda = it doesn't fit me), which the editor could mention.
